questions.0.explain.t: SCA (software composition analysis) inventories what you import and cross-references it with vulnerability databases.

questions.0.options.0.t: Logic errors in your own code

questions.0.options.1.t: Third-party dependencies, their versions, CVEs and licenses

questions.1.explain.t: Most CVEs in real projects come from transitive dependencies that nobody declared directly.

questions.1.options.1.t: A dependency brought in indirectly by another one you declared

questions.1.options.2.t: A dependency copied into the repository

questions.2.explain.t: The code can stand still while a new CVE hits a dependency you already use.

questions.2.options.0.t: Because new CVEs are published after deploy, against code that did not change

questions.2.options.1.t: Because the build changes dependency versions on its own

questions.2.options.3.t: Because the pipeline deletes the results

questions.2.q.t: Why does SCA need to run continuously and not only at build?
